metadata.title: DUONEAR — AI Relationship Companion for Long-Distance Couples
metadata.description: DUONEAR is an AI relationship companion for long-distance couples. Its AI Assistant knows your goals, check-ins, plans, and notes, so every answer feels personal.
metadata.ogTitle: DUONEAR — A Personal AI Assistant for Your Long-Distance Relationship
metadata.ogDescription: Ask anything about your relationship and get answers based on your own goals, daily check-ins, plans, and notes. Resolve disagreements with AI Debate, and grow closer with shared goals, Q&A, and more.

loveLivesHere.alt: Two fluffy cat characters staying connected through DUONEAR
loveLivesHere.description: A cozy place to stay close and connected, even when you're apart.
